## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The containment check in `preview` must be fixed before merge: it compares paths lexically, so a relative path containing `..` reads files outside the home directory. This review read the tests and did not run them.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview(home, relative)`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under the home directory, and `settings_file(home)`, which returns the `settings.toml` path, with tests for both in `tests/test_paths.py`. It also adds `tests/review-note.txt`, a one-line text file that no test or module references.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve both paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` returns the contents of a file outside `home` instead of raising `ValueError`. `Path.is_relative_to` compares path parts lexically, so `home/../secret.txt` passes; a symlink inside `home` that points outside passes the same way. — A caller that passes user-supplied relative paths exposes the first 200 characters of any file the process can read. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and extend `test_preview`, which only exercises an absolute outside path, with a `..` case and a symlink case.
